data.source: Exact companion fixture, selecting the positive apply outcome while keeping the later health failure visible.

constraints: Apply completed is an operation outcome, not proof of workload health; later Health failed remains visible.
Rollback preview requested is not rollback execution or completion.
Recorded chronology does not itself prove causality; retain real event/attempt links and do not invent them.
The selected receipt is read-only; no event-derived action authority.
Typed gate decision receipts remain owned by #235; do not create a second decision store or guess missing history.
clarification: Retain the combined target mel-prod / production. Typed production records retain their actual cluster and namespace identities; generic illustration labels do not redefine those fields.
